This morning my AI built a piece of software for itself. Nobody asked it to. This is our biggest feature launch ever: APPS. We're officially declaring war on SaaS 😄 Here's why: Software until now: guess which SaaS fits → buy it → bend your workflow around someone else's buttons Sauna: chat through the problem → artifacts appear (docs, PDFs, HTML) → do it twice → Sauna builds the app, for you AND for itself → the chat stays docked, and both the app and the agent have full context about you, your team, and every other app The agent "presses" its own buttons, so every run gets quicker. It learns from mistakes at scale, and everything about the job lives in a real database instead of an MD file. Example: you need to send a calendly link to a VIP, but you have no free slots. Sauna rebuilds calendly from a template in seconds, decides from context which dates to offer and which internal events could move for someone this important, and ships it as a GUI. If the VIP books over your team sync, Sauna pings the attendees on Slack and moves it. Painfully simple. https://lnkd.in/gGXiH-qZ ...more ...more

Today we're taking the next step in multiplayer Sauna: Spaces. A Space is a project with permissions. Each one has its own sessions, knowledge, skills, and connections. You invite specific people in, and they inherit the setup you've already built, scoped to exactly what you share. So when a teammate joins your Space, they don't start from a blank agent. They land inside one that already knows the project, already has the right tools connected, already remembers the decisions you've made. An agent gets dramatically more useful once it has your context. Spaces lets you share that context with a team without handing over your entire Sauna. We've had multiplayer in Sauna for a while (sharing your whole Sauna with someone). Spaces is the next step: shared context scoped to a single project instead of all-or-nothing. Spaces is live now. Give it a try at http://go.sauna.ai/fl ...more ...more

CentralComs (YC P26) builds AI agents for residential property management companies that automate maintenance coordination, leasing workflows, and back-office end-to-end, so management teams run more smoothly and earn more with the same team size. Property management operations are relentless, high-stakes, hands-on operations built on relationships with owners, tenants, and vendors that take years to earn and seconds to lose. It's overwhelmingly manual: roughly 90% of the work is still done by hand, and extremely labor-intensive, with 89% of property management companies outsourcing work to teams overseas. Maintenance requests, leasing inquiries, repair verification, lockouts, owner updates: almost everyone kicks off a back-and-forth that can drag on for weeks. Someone answers, gathers details, routes the task, chases it down, and follows up. It's constant, repetitive, and easy to let slip, and the more units you manage, the worse it gets. A unit that sits unleased loses thousands in rent, an ignored tenant doesn't renew, and a repair left too long becomes a habitability and liability problem. CentralComs runs that work for you. It watches every ticket, pieces together the full story across tenants, vendors, and owners, and proactively gathers the missing details needed to push a request forward. It follows up with the right party at the right moment to keep operations moving, integrating with the property management systems you already use, so there's nothing new to learn. CentralComs is built with deep industry experience across both engineering and property management. The founders, Kyle Chang and Kevin Z Wong , grew up as children of property managers and understand this problem firsthand. They watched their parents spend nights and weekends driving between cities for repairs and answering tenants late into the evening. Kyle brings deep enterprise software experience from Nvidia, Cushman & Wakefield, NASA JPL, and Samsung. Kevin was a founding engineer at a venture-backed startup and grew his own AI marketing agency to five figures. If you run or operate a residential property management company and you're feeling the squeeze of rising staffing costs, growing operational complexity, or simply looking to scale your operations without increased headcount, CentralComs is built for you. Book a demo at centralcoms.com or reach out to the founders at contact@centralcoms.com . Congrats to the team on the launch! https://lnkd.in/gaxZx8UN ...more ...more
